newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand dollar closes unchanged.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand dollar closes unchanged.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed almost where it began on Friday after a slight dip in morning trade.
The kiwi ended at US$0.7064/71 against its 0.7067/71 opening while the Trade-Weighted Index finished at 67.43 against its 67.41 opening.
Dealers said there was mild local selling early on, particularly on the crosses against the yen and Australian dollar, but it was met by Asian buying interest.
Dealers expect the kiwi to remain within a narrow range until after the New Year.
